1.consolidated_definition: Grageas. Pequeñas piezas dulces y coloreadas que se esparcen sobre bizcochos. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. Banana split, ingredientes: 1 plátano, 3 bolas de helado de distintos sabores; salsa de chocolate, caramelo y fresa; coco rallado, sprinkles o trocitos de chocolate, pistachos, nata en spray y guindas
1.en_consolidated_definition: Sprinkles. Small sweet and colored pieces that are sprinkled over biscuits. Anglicism raw, frequent. Banana split, ingredients: 1 banana, 3 scoops of ice cream in different flavors; chocolate sauce, caramel, strawberry sauce; shredded coconut, sprinkles or chocolate chips, pistachios, whipped cream, and maraschino cherries
